messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Selling or giving away Adderall is against the law.

Extended-release formulations of Adderall (Adderall XR) are only used to treat ADHD.
Triplet: ["Adderall XR", "is formulation type", "extended-release"]

The relation 'is formulation type' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is a specific formulation type of the drug specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
B. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
C. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
D. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
E. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
